review: Reviewed Ivo's round-4 request 'Prepare a substantial meal' and the World Agent's develop review (learning 1): the smallest general food-preparation operation, cold hand portioning and combining of already edible owned food without heat or equipment, with nutrition unchanged by preparation, eating left to the existing eat path and experience policy, and no stacked rewards. The existing prepare-food@1 (ex11 scope) is a different transformation (hand-mashing into averaged portions with a mass-based work rule and learning 2) and collective-material-combine@1 (ex12 scope) excludes food, so neither is an equivalent; their infrastructure is reused instead. Implemented food-preparation@1 in scope long-ex15 with modes start, resume and cancel and the single preparation cold-combine. Start takes 1-24 exact owned, unreserved {itemId, quantity} allocations in 0.1 steps of one food; each must be unspoiled, untreated and actually edible, and the person's own food record must show it as edible with toxicity 0. Work equals the selected quantity at one food unit per round and one energy per unit worked (Ivo's 3 berries take 3 rounds and 3 energy; a final partial unit costs its fraction); start pays the first increment, the same request continues each round, resume pays the next increment after revalidating every reserved ingredient (present, full quantity, unspoiled) and energy, and too little energy pauses without spending. At start the selected quantities move through the existing collective-work escrow into a reserved, carried, owned in-progress portion that keeps origin, harvest date and decay and keeps ageing; a round without paid work pauses the process. Completion atomically replaces the escrow with one carried stack of the same food (resource unchanged, same quantity and mass) whose original lots are kept as flat componentLots through material-lots.ts, so it eats exactly like the raw food through eat (same nutrition and toxicity per unit, eat's energy cost and satiety cap, partial eating debits those lots), each lot spoils under the existing rule with no shelf-life reset, and the meal-experience record (substantialNutrition 8, mealWindow 10) uses the same food, method and realized nutrition as eating it raw (quality from the oldest lot's decay), which deduplicates raw and prepared forms. A lost or spoiled reserved ingredient stops the work and returns the survivors in their current condition; cancel returns the remaining reserved food in its current condition without refunding energy or time; death stops the work and leaves the unfinished food on the ground once. Events: food-preparation-started, -progress, -paused, -resumed, -cancelled, -failed and -completed (the last names the output item, nominal nutrition 24 and toxicity 0 for Ivo's batch) carry actor, work id, actual input references and quantities, position, progress and tick; the job state is kept in the person's long:work:food-preparation state, and job and output carry visual metadata (component prepared-food, mode cold-combined, state, progress, quantity, ingredient shares and palette); no viewer component is added, so nothing draws a bowl, utensil, fire or steam. Modeling assumptions: hands are not represented, so a living person is treated as having usable hands; one food per batch only, because the existing eat debits component lots in order and no consistent per-portion mixture rule is represented, so mixing berries with roots is rejected rather than averaged; inputs with another represented treatment (water composition, drying, layers, equipment or other processing) are rejected; known safety means the person's own discovery record with toxicity 0; the prepared stack keeps the ingredient's resource and meal method 'unprocessed', since no washing, cutting, heating or other physical change occurs; the completion event is the practice evidence but is never qualified, so preparing earns no milestone, pleasure or other reward and any satisfaction comes only from the existing eat policy; cancel costs no energy. Reuse: collective-work.ts (allocations, escrow, paid work, stop), material-lots.ts (conserved component lots, refresh without rejuvenation), collective-food-profile.ts, the forest eat path, forest-experience meal policy and the forest decay loop, all unchanged; no other experiment changes because only the new long-ex15 package and its registration were added. This is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release: the specification is self-consistent and every cost and effect is implemented with real energy, time, material and events; mixed-food meals and heated, wet or tool-based modes are reported as not represented.
